Cross the bridge and park immediately on the other side. Trailhead is approximately 50 meters up spur road to the right. 4x4 Vehicle Access: Branch 12 (FROM HURLEY FSR) To Tenquille Lake Trail Drive past Lillooet River access on Hurley FSR - zero your odometer at bridge, at approximately 7KM take RH (up) turnoff to towns of Bralorne/Goldbridge. Approximately 20 Km past Lillooet River bridge, look for the Hurley River/Tenquille Branch sign ('Branch 12') - turn right here. Distance to the trailhead is approx. 5 KM. PLEASE BE CAUTIOUS OF ACTIVE LOGGING TRUCKS WHEN ACESSING FSR
